name: BTC short-horizon realized volatility
description: One-second causal observations of the ready BTC spot reference are converted to simple basis-point returns. volatility_bps_15s and volatility_bps_60s are the root mean square of the latest 15 and 60 returns. short_long_ratio is the 15-return value divided by the 60-return value; when both windows have zero root-mean-square volatility, the ratio is defined as 1 and regime is stable. Regime is contracting at or below 0.8, expanding at or above 1.2, and stable between those boundaries. The 0.8 and 1.2 regime boundaries are initial research thresholds that require empirical calibration; the return and root-mean-square formulas are not heuristic thresholds. Any missing or non-ready one-second reference observation breaks continuity and restarts the 60-return warm-up. Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
